lit.\u0027¿Cuál de estos NO tiene membrana?\: "Which of these does NOT have a membrane?"
lit.\u0027¿Qué estructura regula el paso de: "Which structure regulates the passage of substances between nucleus and cytoplasm?"
lit.\u0027¿Qué orgánulo produce la mayor par: "Which organelle produces most of the ATP of the animal cell?"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEn la \u003cb\u003ema:
"

In the matrix and the cristae of the mitochondrion nutrients are oxidized and ATP is produced (cellular respiration). They have a double membrane, their own DNA and their own ribosomes: signs of their endosymbiotic origin.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLa \u003cb\u003eenvol:
"

The nuclear envelope (double membrane) has pores through which RNAs leave and proteins enter. Inside, the chromatin (DNA + histones) contains the genes and the nucleolus makes the ribosome subunits.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLas proteínas del ret:
"

Proteins from the reticulum travel in vesicles to the cis face of the Golgi apparatus, where they are modified and sorted. They leave through the trans face and go to the membrane (exocytosis), the lysosomes or other destinations.

Watch the bright vesicle moving along the secretory pathway.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLos \u003cb\u003eliso:
"

The lysosomes contain hydrolytic enzymes that digest molecules, bacteria and old organelles. The peroxisomes oxidize fatty acids and break down hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) with catalase.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLos \u003cb\u003eribo:
"

The ribosomes translate mRNA into proteins. Those attached to the rough reticulum make proteins that are secreted or go to membranes; the free ones make those of the cytosol.

The smooth reticulum synthesizes lipids and detoxifies.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eTodos los componentes:
"

All the components work in coordination: the nucleus sends instructions, the ribosomes and reticula manufacture, the Golgi packages, the mitochondria provide energy and the cytoskeleton supports and transports.

Switch to Functions above to color by system, or click on any component.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eTres redes de fibras:
"

Three networks of fibers give shape, strength and movement: microtubules (blue, originating at the centrosome), actin filaments (pink, under the membrane) and intermediate filaments (green, anchoring the nucleus).

The centrosome with its two centrioles organizes the mitotic spindle.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eUna \u003cb\u003ebica:
"

A phospholipid bilayer with proteins separates the cell from its surroundings. It is selective: it lets some substances through and holds back others.

The yellow dots are the phospholipid heads; the blue proteins are channels and transporters. Below, the microvilli increase the surface. Inside is the cytosol, the gel where metabolism takes place.

"
lit.\u0027«Funciones» pinta cada componente: "“Functions” paints each component according to the system it belongs to."
